organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Nonprofits to look up, by EIN (e.g. "27-1067272") or name keyword (e.g. "code for america"). Name searches use the top match. One lookup is billed per entry.

state.title: State filter (optional)
state.description: Two-letter state code to disambiguate name searches with common names (e.g. "CA"). Ignored for EIN lookups.

maxFilingsReturned.title: Max filings per org
maxFilingsReturned.description: Maximum number of most recent Form 990 filing years to return per organization.
